QuestInfo.0: It's time for you to take your second test.
QuestInfo.1: This next part will test your courage. Eliminate #b#eStumpy#n#k, the king of Gusty Peak.\r\n#bFind Stumpy in #e#m102020500##n.#k

0.0: The second exam will test your courage. Face #b#eStumpy#k#n, the king of Gusty Peak, and show me the extent of your bravery.
0.1: I'll send you to the #bGusty Peak#k for the exam. Accept when you're ready. You have to defeat #bStumpy#k, not just any monster.

1.0: Congratulations! You passed the test. You can now become an Apprentice Knight. I'll see you again once you have done so.

mob.0: Stumpy can be found in Gusty Peak of Perion.
